==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "attraction name" with the appropriate information.

<code><nowiki>{{GalaxysEdge|''ATTRACTION NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}</nowiki></code>

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{GalaxysEdge|Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{GalaxysEdge|Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities}}

{{Interlang
|es=Plantilla:GEAtr
}}
